definitions.gloss: annex; annex building; secondary building; wing
definitions.explanation: A supplementary building that is separate from but belongs to the same institution as the main building. Used for hotels, museums, hospitals, and other facilities with multiple structures.

examples.japanese: お{部屋|へや}は{別館|べっかん}になります。
examples.english: Your room is in the annex.

examples.japanese: {会議室|かいぎしつ}は{別館|べっかん}の3{階|かい}にあります。
examples.english: The meeting room is on the third floor of the annex.

examples.japanese: {別館|べっかん}には{温泉|おんせん}{付|つ}きの{特別室|とくべつしつ}がある。
examples.english: The annex has special rooms with private hot springs.

notes:
A secondary building belonging to the same institution as the main building ({本館|ほんかん}). Very common at Japanese hotels, where the {別館|べっかん} may have a different character or price range from the main building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別館|べっかん}の{部屋|へや}: annex room
- {本館|ほんかん}と{別館|べっかん}: main building and annex
- {別館|べっかん}に{泊|と}まる: to stay in the annex

USAGE:
At Japanese inns ({旅館|りょかん}) and hotels, the {別館|べっかん} sometimes offers rooms at a different price point or with a different atmosphere from the {本館|ほんかん}. It can be either more or less prestigious depending on the facility.

RELATED TERMS:
- {本館|ほんかん}: main building
- {新館|しんかん}: new building/wing
- {離|はな}れ: detached building — a smaller, separate structure, often more private and exclusive
